notes: Family keys are the tier labels from the routing policy; values are provider model ids as the Codex CLI names them.

The shipped ids were transcribed from a codex-cli 0.153.4 model picker; they are configured, not verified, and provider ids change without notice. Confirm them against your own installation before relying on a generated role.
A null value is legal and means unresolved; the doctor reports it as UNKNOWN, the renderer skips the roles that need it, and nothing substitutes a default.
After changing an id, regenerate roles with: python harness/tools/native_routing.py render
